the 19 Sug1 proteasomal subunits, which are not required for proteasomal degradation, are crucial for the initial chromatin remodeling events required for cytokine-inducibility of MHC-II and class II trans-activator (CIITa) promoters, and that the 19 S ATPase Sug1 may be a critical regulator of the MLL/COMPAS complexes.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the 19s proteasome is important for the initial chromatin reorganization required for transcriptional activation, and that the 19 s proteasome is not required for the subsequent steps of the transcriptional activation process.
the 19 S proteasome is involved in the initial reprogramming of chromatin structure, and that this is independent of the role of proteasome in protein degradation.
